This shifts all subsequent data to the wrong columns, causing the "Name" field to read incorrectly or disappear.

Desktop systems usually end lines with `\n` or `\r\n`. Some mobile file formats (or older exports accessible via mobile file pickers) use a single Carriage Return (`\r`) to mark the end of a line.
